formula: prepend the immediately preceding valid event's final canonical RD frame to the current event (reset on an RD-missing event), convert dB amplitude to relative linear power and sum 21 range rows into a 384-bin velocity profile; assign adjacent-frame cosine mean/minimum, adjacent peak-velocity drift mean/maximum divided by the canonical velocity span, and near-zero (+/-2 m/s) energy-fraction std/minimum to the current causal event
causal_scope: current event plus at most the immediately preceding valid event's final RD frame; no future event or parent-final aggregation
minimum_support: at least two comparison frames from current frames plus the optional causal bridge
invalid_policy: zero values plus internal gating mask; invalid mask is not concatenated

supersedes_candidate.reason: the seed42 candidate measured intra-frame adjacent STFT-window affinity and did not implement the original inter-frame spectral-consistency diagnostic

historical_feature_conception_exposure.source: reconstruction of the original exploratory sample() function, which resets RandomState(3) independently for each label
historical_feature_conception_exposure.consequence: the original V16 test split is feature-conception-exposed for V21a and cannot serve as an unbiased final holdout for this feature family

paired_protocol.initialization: same seed43 random baseline initialization; copy all shared tensors and zero only the new Fusion columns; do not fine-tune the trained Baseline checkpoint

train_only_feature_diagnostic.role: train-only physical readiness and attribution; no validation value or learned decision threshold is consumed

evaluation.primary: development validation parent-final KnownGate macro_f1 delta
